snippet.title: Wipe Them Out! — Official Trailer | Hand-Drawn Zombie Incremental Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! Link in bio!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154590/Wipe_Them_Out/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=wishlist&utm_content=trailer

Wipe them out is a hand-drawn incremental zombie-blasting game. Shoot zombies, collect scrap, and upgrade your weapons and defenses. Face increasingly powerful horde as you grow stronger with every upgrade. Protect your wall and enjoy the satisfaction of tearing through countless zombies.
